5a5aef6c0e10ea73312b4df1104cea5c8dd76ce4.sourceText: 导航这边主要是下发cmd_vel相关的数据,主要包含vx,vy,wz。这里的wz是wz_navigation，而最终机器人自旋速度是`wz_final = wz_navigation + wz_spin;`（最终自旋速度 = 导航速度 + 自旋速度）
5a5aef6c0e10ea73312b4df1104cea5c8dd76ce4.translatedText: The navigation side mainly issues data related to cmd_vel, primarily including vx, vy, and wz\. Here wz is wz_navigation, while the final robot spin speed is`wz_final = wz_navigation + wz_spin;`(final spin speed = navigation speed \+ spin speed)

5a67eb0eeabedeb8b8e2003cb3f4812204838909.sourceText: 同一角度格内有多个合格点时，只保留水平距离最近的一个。例如，同方向2 m和5 m处各有点，扫描只留2 m；二维扫描不会同时表达它们的高度或多层结构。
5a67eb0eeabedeb8b8e2003cb3f4812204838909.translatedText: When there are multiple qualified points within the same angular cell, only the one with the shortest horizontal distance is retained\. For example, if there are points at 2 m and 5 m in the same direction, the scan retains only the 2 m one; a two\-dimensional scan will not simultaneously represent their heights or multilayer structure\.
